examShortTricks: Trick 1: Sutton and Boveri united Mendel with meiosis: genes are on chromosomes; segregation parallels homologue separation in anaphase-I; independent assortment parallels random metaphase alignment.
Trick 2: Two parallels to quote: (1) alleles pair → homologous chromosome pair; (2) allele separation → anaphase-I disjunction.
Trick 3: Evidence beyond it: chromosome mapping and sex linkage confirmed genes occupy specific chromosome loci.
